messages:
Lena (CEO): @here All-hands reminder — Thursday 10:00am PT. Agenda below, please add any Qs in this thread or drop them in the form: https://forms.redwood.company/ah-q2

Lena (CEO): Agenda: 1) State of the company + metrics (5m) 2) Product roadmap highlights + demo (15m) 3) Infrastructure & reliability update + incident summary (10m) 4) People & hiring snapshot (5m) 5) Q&A (15m)

Lena (CEO): If you want a specific slide called out, paste it here. Recording will be posted in this thread after the meeting. :tv:

AllHands Bot: Reminder scheduled for 30 minutes before meeting. See calendar event: https://meet.redwood.company/ah-q2

Maya (Head of Product): Quick q — demo will include the new routing UI, how long should I plan?

Lena (CEO): @Maya keep it to 8 minutes max, highlight user flows and one rollback story.

Arjun (VP Eng): For infra update I can cover the VM→GPU migration progress and a short summary of the incident last month. Do we want the postmortem link in the deck?

Priya (SRE): Yes please include the incident postmortem link. I'll drop the TL;DR and the mitigations we completed. Postmortem: https://confluence.redwood.company/infra/2024-11-cache-blowup

Sam (People Ops): Heads up — we'll share a hiring heatmap slide. If managers want headcount changes, add them to this thread by EOD Wednesday.

Engineer01: Will there be time for product folks to run breakout polls during Q&A?

Lena (CEO): We have 15m for live Q&A, but if you need a poll, please pre-submit it here so we can queue it.

--- (meeting happens) ---

AllHands Bot: Recording available: https://videos.redwood.company/ah-q2-1712105610.mp4

Lena (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining. Threading key takeaways below — add corrections if I missed anything.

Lena (CEO): TAKEAWAYS: 1) ARR growth on track, new PLG funnel experiments showing +12% activation MoM. 2) Product: routing UI demo -> launching beta next week to 50 customers. 3) Infra: VM→GPU migration at 60% of clusters, last month's cache incident root cause was a global TTL misconfiguration; full mitigations rolled out. 4) Hiring: prioritize infra SRE and product design in Q2.

Arjun (VP Eng): Action items: - follow up with critical customers on beta (assigned: Eng Customer Success) - finalize rolling fallback plan for legacy models (assigned: runtime team)

Priya (SRE): Incident follow-ups: automated TTL-validation check added, pre-deploy chaos test for caching layer scheduled, runbook updated. If you want to review the runbook snippet:

```
name: cache_ttl_check
check: validate_global_ttl
on_fail: alert@sre.team
```

Priya (SRE): We also created a small dashboard showing TTL drift: https://dashboards.redwood.company/d/ttl-drift

Maya (Head of Product): Beta signup sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/beta-signups. Please add customers you want in wave 1 by EOD Monday.

Sam (People Ops): People note: org headcount +7 this quarter (mostly Eng infra and Product). New hires list will be in the people ops digest later today.

Lena (CEO): Recorded Q&A highlights: Q about pricing changes -> no immediate changes planned; we'll run experiments and circle back. Q about Dedicated SLAs -> sales will share updated SLA doc with committed customers next week.

Engineer02: Thanks — the runbook snippet is great. Can SRE add a quick note on expected false positives from TTL check?

Priya (SRE): Yup will add expected FP rates and a suppress window to the check by Friday.

Lena (CEO): Closing note: thanks team, big quarter ahead. If you couldn't make it, watch the recording and flag any follow-ups here. :rocket:
